comment: Extra items an entree needs that its menu name does not mention.
Most composite entrees already spell their parts out - 'Beef, Steak Fingers w/Roll',
'Macaroni and Cheese (C) w/Cornbread Poppers (C)' - and those are split on 'w/'
automatically, so they do not need an entry here. This file is only for the implicit
cases: a burger's bun is never written on the menu.
'when' is matched against the lowercased menu item name. 'needs' is a list of
components; each one is satisfied if any order line contains one of its 'any' words.
Add entries as gaps turn up - no code change required.
